title: Discovery of the Martian ocean shoreline (Brandenburg Ocean)

tellings.quote: There was an ocean on Mars and what happened is we found that there was a shoreline Uh-huh. near Sidonia Mensa

plain: The physicist John Brandenburg says that in the 1980s he and colleagues found an ancient shoreline on Mars near Cydonia Mensa, a region of the planet, showing that Mars once had an ocean. He tells it as his own discovery and credits a conference paper he wrote in 1986 on the planet's ancient ocean. He raises it because a past ocean would make it more likely that Mars once held life.
